function.name: str_replace_editor

args.old_str:
match (l.evaluate(None)?, r.evaluate(None)?) {
                    (Boolean(true), Boolean(true)) => Boolean(true).into(),
                    (Boolean(false), _) => Boolean(false).into(),
                    (_, Boolean(false)) => Boolean(false).into(),
                    (Boolean(l), Boolean(r)) => Boolean(l && r).into(),
                    _ => And(l.into(), r.into()),
                }
